shortDescription: Exports the APM policy or APM access profile from remote nodes

options.name: dest
options.description: A directory to save the file into.

options.name: file
options.description: The name of the file to be created on the remote device for downloading.

options.name: force
options.description: If C(false), the file will only be transferred if it does not exist in the the destination.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the APM policy or APM access profile exported to create a file on the remote device for downloading.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition which contains the APM policy or APM access profile to export.

options.name: type
options.description: Specifies the type of item to export from the device.
